load_obj_vertices_and_faces: load a Wavefront .obj file and return vertices and faces as CUDA tensors
load_obj_with_textures: load an .obj file with surface textures by specifying load_texture and texture_res parameters
load_obj_normalized: load an .obj file and normalize vertices into a unit cube centered at zero
load_mtl_materials: load diffuse colors and texture filenames from a Wavefront .mtl material library file
load_textures_from_obj_mtl: load texture maps from an .obj and .mtl pair and return a CUDA texture tensor
